**One Layers panel, with a lock.** The Layers panel now lists every layer of the map by the slot of a block it paints: terrain mixes, ground covers (plants, Frost, Lava), trees and objects, the sub-canopy under the trees, then the tree sizes and the annotations, as the new page Layers of the guide explains. Each row has its eye and a lock: a locked ground cover or tree layer keeps its blocks, so painting another layer of its slot, or the right button, leaves them as they are until you unlock it — paint a new forest around the one you placed by hand without touching it. Its menu opens its settings in a dialog of their own (Settings…), and moves it up or down its section.
